profile.name: Aditya Thete
profile.title: Machine Learning & Generative AI Engineer
profile.badge: Open to GenAI & Agentic AI Roles
profile.summary: Generative AI and Machine Learning Engineer with 3+ years of experience designing and deploying LLM-powered products, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and Agentic AI systems across Healthcare, Life Sciences, FMCG, and E-Commerce domains. Proficient in LangChain, LangGraph, GPT-4o, ChromaDB, Hugging Face, and Azure OpenAI, with a strong track record of building production-grade AI pipelines, integrating AI solutions with enterprise APIs and applications, and translating complex business requirements into scalable, impact-driven AI products.

projects.title: Production RAG Chatbot for Medical Question Answering
projects.tagline: Enterprise RAG Pipeline with 92% Faithfulness Score on RAGAS
projects.description: Architected and deployed an end-to-end Medical RAG chatbot engineered for high accuracy, grounded medical document Q&A, and minimal hallucinations.
highlights: Built end-to-end Medical RAG Chatbot using LangChain, ChromaDB, OpenAI text-embedding-ada-002, and GPT-4o.
Covered comprehensive pipeline: PDF ingestion, semantic chunking, Top-K vector retrieval, and FastAPI REST endpoint.
Reduced LLM hallucinations through targeted prompt engineering and retrieval tuning, achieving a 92% Faithfulness score on RAGAS benchmarks.
Deployed as a scalable, real-time inference service with persistent ChromaDB storage and low-latency API access.

projects.title: E-Commerce Complaint Classifier & Auto-Router
projects.tagline: Automated Multi-Class Customer Issue Triaging with 90%+ Accuracy
projects.description: Engineered an intelligent customer support classification and routing system using deep learning LSTM to automate manual ticket routing entirely.
highlights: Built multi-class NLP complaint classification system using TensorFlow LSTM with end-to-end data pipeline.
Engineered text cleaning, tokenisation, embeddings, sequence padding, and handled class imbalance.
Achieved 90%+ classification accuracy with confidence scoring across 6 complaint categories: Delivery, Billing, Refunds, Returns, Fulfillment, and Account Support.
Implemented automated complaint routing mapping each predicted category to its responsible business department, eliminating manual triaging effort.

projects.title: Employee Churn Prediction & Retention Analytics
projects.tagline: Predictive Attrition Modeling with 90%+ ROC-AUC for Enterprise FMCG
projects.description: Developed an end-to-end ML predictive pipeline analyzing workforce attrition drivers and providing proactive retention strategies to executive stakeholders.
highlights: Built end-to-end employee churn prediction system using Python, Scikit-learn, Random Forest, and XGBoost.
Executed extensive Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), feature engineering, customer/employee segmentation, and predictive modeling.
Achieved 90%+ ROC-AUC accuracy with a 30% improvement in identifying high-risk employees for timely interventions.
Delivered actionable attrition insights directly to business stakeholders, supporting retention planning and long-term revenue preservation for an FMCG client.

bullets: Designing and delivering enterprise AI consulting solutions using LangChain and LangGraph — building end-to-end RAG pipelines, autonomous AI agents, and multi-step agentic workflows tailored to specific client business requirements.

Implementing production-grade RAG architectures with vector database integration (ChromaDB, Pinecone, FAISS), prompt engineering optimisation, and LLM fine-tuning to improve response accuracy, reduce hallucinations, and ensure reliable outputs in client-facing AI applications.

Integrating AI solutions with client APIs, enterprise applications, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), ensuring scalable, production-ready deployments while collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex business needs into practical, measurable AI outcomes.
Contributed to building a RAG-based knowledge retrieval system designed to improve access to operational and marketing information for restaurant and cloud kitchen businesses.
Engineered end-to-end document ingestion, embedding generation, and vector database pipelines using ChromaDB and semantic search techniques for accurate and scalable information retrieval.
Collaborated closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements, validate system outputs, and support the end-to-end implementation of Generative AI solutions in a production environment.

Designed and delivered 5+ Machine Learning, NLP, and LLM-based solutions for enterprise clients across Healthcare, Automotive, and Analytics domains, translating complex business requirements into production-ready AI products.

Built and maintained end-to-end AI pipelines covering data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring using Python and AWS cloud technologies, reducing average model deployment time by ~30%.
Worked closely with clients and cross-functional teams across 3+ concurrent projects to ensure solutions were scalable, reliable, and aligned with real business outcomes.
Developed machine learning models to predict employee churn and identify key attrition drivers using HR and performance data, achieving 88%+ accuracy and improving high-risk identification by 30%.
Performed in-depth EDA and feature engineering on 10,000+ employee records to uncover behavioural patterns contributing to attrition.
Presented findings and model outputs to senior stakeholders, directly informing data-driven HR retention strategies at the organisational level.

education.details: Specialized in data-driven business strategy, predictive modeling, statistical analysis, and enterprise analytics.
Foundational training in computer programming, algorithms, mathematics, and engineering problem solving.
